author: Tacowolf99
body: Tacowolf99: I was banned on Nebula almost over a year ago; i got banned on December 4, 2014 for Forcefield hacking. I had played on the server previously for over a year or so, maybe even two, but one night i was playing with one of my friends on nebula and he had downloaded hacks and had convinced me to aswell. This was my first time ever actually hacking in minecraft because i never felt the need to before. This was one of those 5am mistakes that you regret the next day but you never actually think straight that early. It has been quite a while since my ban and believe that i've done my respectable amount of time before posting an appeal and i really hope that you will take my unban into consideration. I am a long time loyal player on the server and really hope to rejoin soon as i loved all the game types and the amazing community. -Tacowolf99

Hello,

Regards,
